problem_restatement.question: Does the exact SP500 v3 route have sufficient side-specific evidence for continued bidirectional V58 authority, and what is the lowest-risk next change if it does not?
inputs: The frozen historical transfer experiment and untouched validation
The v3 technical parity repair and its promotion boundary
Exact v51 and V58 SP500 live lifecycle outcomes
The current unresolved V58 SP500 long and protected order state
constraints: Do not mutate or restart the live system while a position is open
Do not infer a closed result from provisional marked PnL
Do not relabel technical parity as profitable edge
Do not reopen a rejected mechanism by post-hoc threshold or exit tuning
Any route-side change requires explicit human approval and a verified flat, order-free transition boundary
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Separate technical correctness from economics, reconcile long and short evidence without pooling unrelated symbols, and produce a falsifiable approval-ready transition rather than an automatic change.

identity.exit_contract: fixed 80bps protective stop, no fixed target, completed-1m 100/40/80 profit lock, eligible opposite-intent exit, 24h maximum-hold fallback

technical_route_state.evidence: At the 2026-08-21T13:59:52.489857Z checkpoint, the V58 backend was healthy, preflight was fresh, route submission timing was enforced, venue and ledger were reconciled, and no runtime fault was reported.
failure_modes: A later source-identity change would invalidate this bounded observation
A fresh runtime fault or reconciliation failure would update the assessment immediately
technical_route_state.falsifier: A checkpoint-prefix audit proving route mismatch, late execution, missing protection, unresolved venue divergence, or a runtime fault at this evidence boundary.

failure_modes: The historical midpoint-L2 path is a high-agreement proxy rather than public-trade OHLC
The later v3 adapter repaired technical defects, so this result cannot establish v3 execution parity
The small dollar result does not estimate current portfolio-level loss magnitude
historical_transfer_result.falsifier: A frozen materially comparable non-overlapping window that is positive after exact costs and largest-winner removal, with stable results under the declared friction stress.

repairs: Exchange-boundary freshness instead of local receipt time
Frozen first-observed signal and exit candle prefixes for replay
v3_technical_repair.falsifier: A frozen-prefix replay mismatch, consumed-prefix mutation, source identity drift, or future exact after-cost outcomes that remain non-positive or largest-winner dependent.

limitations: Two trades are not an expectancy estimate
Both exited by the 24-hour fallback rather than a repeatable signal-specific profit exit
The historical selected recipe was short-side negative in both development and untouched validation
exact_resolved_sp500_live_short_evidence.falsifier: A fill-ledger reconciliation changing either lifecycle identity, side, costs, or net PnL.

failure_modes: Marked PnL can reverse before the actual exit
The current path is one lifecycle and cannot establish long-side population expectancy
Changing the route or restarting mid-position could break attribution or protection continuity
current_v58_long.falsifier: The exact exit fill and reconciled costs will replace this provisional state.

current_long_signal_paths.interpretation: The second eligible path was correctly withheld because the long was already open. These are two signal observations but one actual lifecycle; they do not prove duplicate or missed execution.
current_long_signal_paths.falsifier: An exact ledger-prefix audit showing the second event was not withheld for same-direction occupancy or that either event had a different provider, side, or timestamp identity.

exit_challenger_evidence.current_long_relevance: The current long reached only 9.2484bps MFE, so none of the lower predeclared activation thresholds would have locked profit on this path.
exit_challenger_evidence.falsifier: A preregistered exact-v3 lifecycle comparison that improves nominal and stress results after costs and largest-winner removal without harming the opposite side.

lineage_reconciliation.finding: V58 SP500 authority was a documented, explicitly approved ungated live trial with low profitability confidence; it was not evidence-backed promotion and no current routing defect is proven.
lineage_reconciliation.process_control_issue: The earlier ledger closed unchanged v3 reuse and required a materially distinct preregistered mechanism or compatible untouched positive window to reopen it. This audit did not locate a pre-V58 artifact satisfying that reopen rule. The V58 transition contract documents the operator-approved exception, but not new profitability evidence.
failure_modes: A pre-V58 artifact outside the inspected evidence set may satisfy the reopen rule
Operator approval establishes authority to run the trial but does not establish positive expectancy
Pooling prior SPCX losses with SP500 would overstate SP500-specific evidence against the route
lineage_reconciliation.falsifier: A provenance-bound pre-V58 artifact showing a distinct mechanism or a compatible untouched SP500 window that met the recorded reopen criteria.

options.option: Keep bidirectional SP500 unchanged after the current long resolves
options.capital_risk: retains long and short stop exposure
options.benefit: avoids acting on a two-short and one-unresolved-long sample
options.cost: continues a long side with no positive exact resolved evidence and negative historical validation

options.option: Contain SP500 to short-only at the next verified flat, order-free boundary
options.capital_risk: removes future long-side stop exposure while retaining short-side exposure
options.information_value: continues causal evidence on the only side with positive exact live closes
options.benefit: matches authority to side-specific evidence without inventing a new entry or exit mechanism
options.cost: may discard future profitable longs and still relies on only two short outcomes

options.benefit: strongest containment of a historically rejected family
options.cost: discards two positive exact short outcomes and one non-crypto diversification path

options.option: Lower the profit-lock or add a fixed target
options.capital_risk: could truncate winners and add turnover
options.benefit: could reduce giveback on paths that first exceed activation
options.cost: existing exact-mark challengers do not validate a replacement and the current long never reached even 25bps MFE

options.option: Raise or retune the pressure threshold
options.cost: no preregistered causal evidence and it would reopen a rejected family by tuning on observed outcomes

recommendation.immediate_action: Make no live change while lifecycle xyz:SP500:521918499754 remains open. Preserve the owned protective stop and exact exit attribution.
recommendation.preferred_next_flat_transition: After the current long resolves and venue, ledger, and owned-order state are verified flat and order-free, change SP500 from bidirectional to short-only without changing leverage, sizing, stop, profit lock, opposite-intent exit, or maximum hold.
recommendation.approval_scope: Future SP500 short-only containment at the next verified flat and order-free boundary; no manual close and no mid-position restart.
recommendation.reason: Long-side authority has negative historical validation and no positive exact resolved live lifecycle. Short-side authority has two positive exact live closes, so side containment is more evidence-conserving than wholesale removal, but the short edge remains unproven.
not_claimed: No claim that SP500 short-only has positive durable expectancy
No claim that the current long will close at a loss
No claim that the active exit is optimal
No claim that V58 inclusion was a technical bug

pre_transition: Wait for the current long to resolve under its frozen exit contract
Reconcile the actual exit fill, fees, funding, slippage, MFE, MAE, and exit reason
Verify zero SP500 positions and zero SP500 orders at venue and ledger boundaries
Create a recoverable config and runtime backup
Verify the profile fingerprint and diff only the SP500 long-side authority
technical_acceptance: Unit and configuration tests prove SP500 long intent is withheld and SP500 short intent remains executable
Focused route, exit, protection, and checkpoint tests pass
Full non-network Python suite and Rust TUI suite pass
Post-start acceptance proves the expected profile fingerprint, healthy heartbeat, fresh preflight, zero faults, ledger/venue reconciliation, and protective-stop ownership

economic_checkpoint.review_time: After three additional independent resolved SP500 short lifecycles or 30 calendar days, whichever occurs first
reported_metrics: Exact net PnL after fees and funding
MFE, MAE, giveback, holding time, and exit-reason distribution
economic_checkpoint.update_condition: Evidence supporting continued short-only authority would require positive after-cost PnL, profit factor above one, and positive net PnL after removing the largest winner, with unchanged source and execution identity.
economic_checkpoint.failure_condition: Non-positive after-cost or largest-winner-removed results, source drift, protection failure, or execution mismatch would trigger a new report and explicit decision request; performance alone is not an automatic hidden gate.

validation_plan_if_approved.rollback: If the approved transition introduces a technical mismatch, restore the backed-up V58 configuration only at a verified flat and order-free boundary. Do not re-enable long authority automatically.

uncertainties_and_risks: The current long is unresolved and may materially update the long-side diagnosis.
Two resolved shorts and one unresolved long are far below what is needed for a durable expectancy estimate.
Historical transfer evidence used a technically older mechanism and price-path proxy, while live outcomes use v3 and real fills.
A short-only transition reduces one unsupported exposure direction but does not prove portfolio profitability.
The 30-day or three-trade review clock is an operational diagnostic checkpoint, not a statistically sufficient sample guarantee.
No automated performance rejection gate is introduced by this recommendation.

single_highest_value_next_investigation.experiment: Resolve and reconcile the current exact SP500 long under the frozen V58 contract, then compare its actual long-side economics with the two exact live short outcomes before any flat-boundary transition.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.capital_downside: bounded by the existing owned protective stop subject to gap and slippage risk
single_highest_value_next_investigation.completion_event: Actual exit fill reconciled with venue, ledger, costs, path, and reason
